meta.disclaimer: Seed catalog for a new-car buying aid, not a certified data source. Figures come from manufacturer WLTP/spec sheets and third-party charging-curve databases and have not all been cross-checked per car against one primary source; cars flagged with a notes field below need that check before go-live. Independent of any single car: every one of the 15 entries implied a WLTP consumption (usableKwh / wltpKm) below the 15-20 kWh/100 km band typical for these vehicle classes, ranging 10.4-14.7 kWh/100 km across the catalog. This may mean published WLTP ranges here were sourced against gross (not usable) battery capacity, or that several wltpKm values are optimistic - either way, do not treat wltpKm as an independent cross-check on usableKwh until each cars gross-capacity figure is recorded too.
meta.confidence: seed - unverified. Four cars carry a specific notes flag (tesla-m3, tesla-my, mercedes-eqa, renault-5); see lib/engine/charge.ts for a related flag on assumed 10-80% charging averages (AVG_KW_10_80), extended 12.09.2026 to cover kia-ev3 alongside the original skoda-elroq finding.
